Steps
Step 1.
Complete the application for graduate admission.
You should apply as an international student if you require a visa to enter the United States. You may complete an application using one of the following methods:
• Online
• Visit Campus411 All-in-1, Berkman Hall, Room 116
Some programs require a supplemental application. Read the information on admissions requirements by program.
Applications must be submitted and all admission materials received by the application deadline date:
Fall Semester – July 21st
Spring Semester – December 10th
Summer Semester – April 14th
Some programs have earlier deadlines. We recommend you check online to see if your program has an earlier deadline.
There is no application fee to apply to CSU for Graduate Programs*.
*Excluding external application fees for non-CSU based program applications
Step 2.
Submit official transcripts.
Request complete school records (transcripts, mark sheets, certificates) from all post-secondary institutions that you attended. All school records should be submitted in the original language and should be accompanied by a certified English translation. Cleveland State University must see all attempts at all exams to properly evaluate the credentials for a U.S. grade point average.
All records must be official and sent directly to CSU from your previous institutions by mail or to the below admission email inbox:
Cleveland State University
Application Processing Center
1836 Euclid Avenue, UN 443
Cleveland, OH 44115
or graduate.admissions@csuohio.edu
Please note that all credentials submitted in support of your application become the property of Cleveland State University and cannot be released under any circumstance.
Step 3.
Submit official entrance exam scores (GRE, GMAT, MAT).
Not all programs require entrance exam scores. Read the information on admissions requirements by program.
• Graduate Record Exam (GRE) information is available online. Our institution code is 1221. No program code is required.
• Graduate Management Aptitude Test (GMAT) information is available online. Our institution code is 832-VP-99.
• The Miller Analogies Test (MAT) can be taken on campus through Testing Services.
All test scores must be official and sent directly to CSU from the testing agency.
Step 4.
Submit supplementary materials (recommendation letters, goal statement, writing sample).
Not all programs require supplementary application materials. Read the information on admissions requirements by program.
Download letter of recommendation cover sheet or ask your recommenders to submit their letters by email to allin1@csuohio.edu. Recommendation letters can also be managed and submitted by logging back into your online application and clicking the “Manage Recommendations” link.
Supplementary materials can be submitted by email to allin1@csuohio.edu.
Supplementary materials sent by U.S. mail should be addressed to:
Cleveland State University
Application Processing Center
1836 Euclid Avenue, UN 443
Cleveland, OH 44115
Supplementary materials delivered in-person or by a delivery service (UPS, FedEx, DHL) should be delivered to:
Campus411 All-in-1
Berkman Hall, Room 116
1899 East 22nd Street
Cleveland, OH 44115
Step 5.
Submit proof of English proficiency.
Graduate applicants must submit proof of English proficiency. CSU offers students the following choices to prove English language proficiency:
Meet minimum test score requirements:
TOEFL iBT (Internet-Based): 78 and at least 17 in each section
TOEFL PBT (Paper-Based): 550
IELTS: 6.0 and at least 5.0 in each section
PTE (Pearsons Test of English): 50
iTEP: 3.8
Duolingo score 110 (https://englishtest.duolingo.com/)
Successful completion of CSU's IELP (Intensive English Language Program) Advanced Level, with a grade of 80% or better
Completion of English language studies (Level 112) from any ELS Language Center
Proof of graduation from a secondary school or accredited college/university in the U.S. or from one of the TOEFL exempted countries.
Note: The College of Engineering has higher TOEFL (iBT) subscore requirements: 78 (Reading: 20, Listening: 21, Writing: 17, Speaking: 20)
Step 6.
Submit financial documents.
In order to receive a certificate of eligibility for a student visa (Form I-20 or Form DS-2019) from CSU, all international students must submit documentation of financial support for one academic year. While this is not required for admission consideration, you may choose to submit this documentation with your application materials. For more information about finances, please see Financial Documents.
My experience at Cleveland State University was incredible. There are plenty opportunities for career development. CSU is the best university to start your journey toward your American dream.
RAVIRAJ PATEL
MASTER OF SCIENCE, ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING, ’18
